infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the "Hive" hookah lounge in the Malevicha street no. 5 building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Relaxation room key (Relax) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the relaxation room inside one of the city offices.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest The Secret to Productivity

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text: In different locations inside the Zmeisky 6 building at Streets of Tarkov. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the "Hive" hookah lounge in the Malevicha street no. 5 building at Streets of Tarkov

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Valuables, Drinks)
- Multiple Sports bags
- Possible LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Black) on the mannequin
- Possible LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Olive Drab) on the mannequin
- Possible LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Coyote Tan) on the mannequin
- Possible HighCom Trooper TFO body armor (MultiCam) on the mannequin
- Possible BNTI Zhuk body armor (EMR) on the mannequin
- Possible Interceptor OTV body armor (UCP) on the mannequin

sections.heading: Crafting
